witnesses.originalText: etiam imitatione factorum
witnesses.readingNote: Priestly contemplation of Christ must also result in imitating his deeds
witnesses.speaker: PIUS_X_AUTHOR

witnesses.originalText: quam magna vis consilii virtutisque inde profluat
witnesses.readingNote: Meditation assists pastoral judgment and virtue
witnesses.speaker: PIUS_X_AUTHOR

witnesses.originalText: an lecta et meditata religiose studeat in usu vitae perficere
witnesses.readingNote: Priest should carry reading and meditation into practical life
witnesses.speaker: PIUS_X_AUTHOR

witnesses.originalText: piis divinisque libris longe alios omne genus atque ephemeridum turbam praeoptant
witnesses.readingNote: Warning about replacing spiritual literature with other reading
witnesses.speaker: PIUS_X_AUTHOR

witnesses.originalText: Cum divinarum rerum quotidiana consideratione magni refert
witnesses.readingNote: Meditation and spiritual reading belong together
witnesses.speaker: PIUS_X_AUTHOR

witnesses.originalText: qui alios hortatur et incitat ut labes animi ne morentur debita religione detergere
witnesses.readingNote: Critique of exhorting others to penance while neglecting personal penitence
witnesses.speaker: PIUS_X_AUTHOR

witnesses.originalText: pius animae recessus ad Exercitia, quae vocant, spiritualia
witnesses.readingNote: Annual retreat recommended as an aid to priestly life
witnesses.speaker: PIUS_X_AUTHOR

witnesses.originalText: annuus, si fieri possit
witnesses.readingNote: Annual retreat qualified by feasibility
witnesses.speaker: PIUS_X_AUTHOR

witnesses.originalText: consimilis recessus, ad paucas horas, menstruus
witnesses.readingNote: Monthly shorter retreat or recollection recommended
witnesses.speaker: PIUS_X_AUTHOR

witnesses.originalText: adstrictiorem quamdam sacerdotum, ut fratres addecet, inter se coniunctionem
witnesses.readingNote: Priestly cooperation and brotherhood encouraged
witnesses.speaker: PIUS_X_AUTHOR

witnesses.originalText: ad facultatem doctrinae sacrae excolendam
witnesses.readingNote: Priestly associations foster theological learning
witnesses.speaker: PIUS_X_AUTHOR

witnesses.originalText: Nosmetipsi unam quamdam, bene aptam experti, fovimus in episcopali munere
witnesses.readingNote: Pius X directly says he supported one useful priestly association as bishop
witnesses.speaker: PIUS_X_AUTHOR

witnesses.originalText: Unum nimirum est quod hominem cum Deo coniungat
witnesses.readingNote: Priestly holiness is fundamental beyond professional accomplishments
witnesses.speaker: PIUS_X_AUTHOR

witnesses.originalText: Non manchi da ultimo in verun seminario il direttore spirituale
witnesses.readingNote: Every seminary should have a spiritual director in this historical discipline
witnesses.speaker: PIUS_X_AUTHOR

witnesses.originalText: uomo di prudenza non ordinaria ed esperto nelle vie della perfezione cristiana
witnesses.readingNote: Spiritual director chosen for prudence and experience
witnesses.speaker: PIUS_X_AUTHOR

witnesses.originalText: Gli studi di filosofia, di teologia e delle scienze affini
witnesses.readingNote: Intellectual formation is separately required, not sufficient alone
witnesses.speaker: PIUS_X_AUTHOR

witnesses.originalText: si antepongano le prediche morali a conferenze
witnesses.readingNote: Moral preaching preferred to impressive but less fruitful lectures
witnesses.speaker: PIUS_X_AUTHOR

witnesses.originalText: la fonte precipua della predicazione devono essere le Sacre Scritture
witnesses.readingNote: Scripture principal source of preaching
witnesses.speaker: PIUS_X_AUTHOR

witnesses.originalText: secondo la tradizione della Chiesa, le interpretazioni dei Santi Padri e dei Concili
witnesses.readingNote: Scripture interpreted within Church, Fathers and councils
witnesses.speaker: PIUS_X_AUTHOR

witnesses.originalText: Meglio è che i fedeli si contentino della semplice omelia
witnesses.readingNote: Simple homily better than teaching that harms faith
witnesses.speaker: PIUS_X_AUTHOR

witnesses.originalText: Non già, o Venerabili Fratelli, perché questa azione sia in sé riprovevole
witnesses.readingNote: Lay or popular social action not condemned in itself
witnesses.speaker: PIUS_X_AUTHOR

witnesses.originalText: benché sia lodevole che vadano al popolo
witnesses.readingNote: Priestly service to the people praiseworthy under discipline
witnesses.speaker: PIUS_X_AUTHOR

witnesses.originalText: a scapito della dignità sacerdotale, con danno dei doveri e della disciplina ecclesiastica
witnesses.readingNote: Priestly duties must not be displaced by secular action — quoted earlier papal teaching
witnesses.speaker: LEO_XIII_1902_QUOTED_BY_PIUS_X

witnesses.originalText: promuovere tra il laicato cattolico quelle istituzioni
witnesses.readingNote: Social institutions among laity encouraged — inside 1902 quotation
witnesses.speaker: LEO_XIII_1902_QUOTED_BY_PIUS_X

witnesses.originalText: communiter cum acatholicis, cautione adhibita, laborare pro communi bono
witnesses.readingNote: Cooperation for common good with non-Catholics under safeguards
witnesses.speaker: PIUS_X_AUTHOR

witnesses.originalText: tolerari posse, et permitti catholicis
witnesses.readingNote: Conditional toleration of specified mixed workers associations
witnesses.speaker: PIUS_X_AUTHOR

witnesses.originalText: respicientes peculiarem rei catholicae rationem in Germania
witnesses.readingNote: Decision explicitly tied to German circumstances
witnesses.speaker: PIUS_X_AUTHOR

witnesses.originalText: necesse est ab omni se contineant vel ratione vel re quae cum doctrinis mandatisque Ecclesiae legitimaeve potestatis sacrae non conveniat
witnesses.readingNote: Worker associations must avoid actions contrary to Catholic teaching
witnesses.speaker: PIUS_X_AUTHOR

witnesses.originalText: Nam ea demum est germana adversus Deiparentem relligio, quae profluat animo
witnesses.readingNote: True Marian devotion begins inwardly
witnesses.speaker: PIUS_X_AUTHOR

witnesses.originalText: ut divini Mariae Filii mandatis penitus obtemperemus
witnesses.readingNote: Marian devotion calls for obeying her Son
witnesses.speaker: PIUS_X_AUTHOR

witnesses.originalText: ad imitationem exempli eius omni ope contendere
witnesses.readingNote: The faithful should imitate Mary's example
witnesses.speaker: PIUS_X_AUTHOR

witnesses.originalText: fidem inquimus, spem et caritatem in Deum atque homines
witnesses.readingNote: Faith hope charity are distinguished Marian virtues
witnesses.speaker: PIUS_X_AUTHOR

witnesses.originalText: cumque eo, sui veluti doloris oblita
witnesses.readingNote: Mary's grief is present, though directed in solidarity toward Christ
witnesses.speaker: PIUS_X_AUTHOR

witnesses.originalText: nec tamen dubitat revicturum
witnesses.readingNote: Mary confidently expects Christ's resurrection in Pius X's exposition
witnesses.speaker: PIUS_X_AUTHOR

witnesses.originalText: quod idem Nos egimus decreto, cui initium: Tridentina Synodus
witnesses.readingNote: Pius X refers to his frequent Communion decree
witnesses.speaker: PIUS_X_AUTHOR

witnesses.originalText: quam periculosum exitiosumque sit ad sacram divini illius cibi mensam indigne accedere
witnesses.readingNote: Unworthy Communion warned against — quoted St Charles Borromeo
witnesses.speaker: ST_CHARLES_BORROMEO_QUOTED_BY_PIUS_X

witnesses.originalText: ne forte ex frequentare usu debita tanto mysterio reverentia minuatur
witnesses.readingNote: Frequent Communion must not diminish reverence
witnesses.speaker: PIUS_X_AUTHOR

witnesses.originalText: illustria Christi militum exempla longe magis valitura quam verba
witnesses.readingNote: Historical examples presented as pastorally influential
witnesses.speaker: PIUS_X_AUTHOR

witnesses.originalText: pari misericordia exciperetis
witnesses.readingNote: Return of penitents could be received with mercy
witnesses.speaker: PIUS_X_AUTHOR

witnesses.originalText: si facta promissis convenirent
witnesses.readingNote: Restoration of ministry conditional upon actions matching promises
witnesses.speaker: PIUS_X_AUTHOR

records.questionEn: What did you want Catholic members to protect?

records.questionEn: Is this a universal rule for unions everywhere today?

records.questionEn: Is Communion a reward for people without weakness?

records.questionEn: What should true Marian devotion change in someone's life?
records.narrowClaimScope: Authentic Marian devotion shapes obedience to Christ and imitation of Mary

records.questionEn: What does Mary at Calvary teach about suffering?
records.narrowClaimScope: Mary's faith, hope and charity at Calvary were exercised amid suffering

records.questionEn: Does steadfast faith mean that a person feels no suffering?
records.narrowClaimScope: Faith does not imply the absence of grief

records.questionEn: Did Mary's fidelity at Calvary mean that she felt no grief?
records.narrowClaimScope: The text presents Mary's sorrow without denial of faith in resurrection

records.questionEn: Why connect the virtues of faith and hope with the Cross?
records.narrowClaimScope: Faith, hope and charity are linked to the Cross
